title: Fossil CO2 Emissions Are Set to Fall Slightly in 2026
paragraphs: Every year, scientists count the CO2 from the world. CO2 makes the Earth warmer. This year the news is a little good.
Scientists think CO2 from oil, gas and coal will fall by 0.4 percent in 2026. Solar and wind power are growing fast. People use less oil too.
But the fall is very small. Total CO2 is still high. Scientists say we need much more clean energy.
